serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
…
I don’t wanna read this email anymore… {{wi}}misfortunes never come singly…
Eh… {{wi}}I need to face reality and read this.
Specially prepared job offers?! You gotta be kidding me! They were all minimum wage jobs for nobodies! I can find such offers on the net myself!
Are they for real? They will take my only income? I need this money to live!  For Christ's sake there’s gotta be a way to fix this hot mess. 
Maybe I will come up with some excuse like ‘I’m sick’ or something. Let’s write an email to them and...
…
Dick heads.
What am I supposed to do now? Unemployment benefit wasn’t much, but 800$ every week still helped me a bunch. 
I need to go to that labour office as soon as possible.
